The '''Adarlon spaceport''' was a beautiful and chic installation, located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Adarlon/Legends|Adarlon]]. It was connected by [[whisper-transit]] line to the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Balderdash]].
